categories.main_business_segments: Actions Technology Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, design, and sales of mid-to-high-end intelligent audio SoC chips. Its main product lines include smart wireless audio SoC chips, edge AI processor chips, and portable audio-video SoC chips, serving applications such as Bluetooth speakers, wireless home theater systems, smartwatches, AI glasses, wireless microphones, and gaming headsets. The company operates mainly in the AIoT domain, integrating AI capabilities into edge devices for enhanced audio and smart interaction experiences.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chip design technologies including a tri-core heterogeneous architecture combining CPU, DSP, and NPU, with the NPU based on SRAM analog-digital hybrid in-memory computing (CIM) technology to achieve high energy efficiency and low power consumption. It has proprietary high-performance audio ADC/DAC technology, low-power Bluetooth communication, high-bandwidth low-latency private wireless communication protocols, and sophisticated audio algorithm processing for high-quality sound. The company follows a fabless production model, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized manufacturers while focusing on chip design and software development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading international and domestic brands in the audio and smart wearable sectors such as Harman, Bose, LG, Sony, Xiaomi, and others. The company serves markets for Bluetooth audio devices, wireless home theater systems, smart wearables, AI glasses, and gaming peripherals. Its products are integrated into consumer electronics, smart home, smart office, and intelligent education sectors, targeting both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Zhuhai, China, with subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Hefei. Its sales and operations cover both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, with significant revenue generated from overseas customers. The company’s products have penetrated global first-tier brands, indicating a broad geographic footprint primarily in Asia and extending to global markets through its brand partners.
categories.supply_chain_position: Actions Technology operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, positioned upstream in the semiconductor supply chain. It focuses on chip design and software development, while wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing are outsourced to foundries and specialized service providers. The company also provides integrated software and algorithm solutions to downstream customers, including ODMs and OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing low-power, high-performance AIoT chips with integrated AI acceleration engines, particularly for edge devices. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance AI computing power, wireless communication technologies (including Bluetooth 5.4, LE Audio, 2.4G private protocols, UWB, WiFi, and Starlink), and audio quality algorithms. The company emphasizes developing tri-core heterogeneous architectures (CPU, DSP, NPU) with CIM technology, expanding AI applications in smart audio, wearables, and IoT devices, and strengthening its ecosystem with software development kits and AI tools.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of its SoC chips to brand customers and ODM/OEM partners. It operates on a buyout sales model, mainly through distributors with some direct sales. Additionally, it provides integrated hardware-software solutions, including software development platforms and AI algorithm libraries, to support customer product development and reduce time-to-market.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Actions Technology is a leading player in the mid-to-high-end intelligent audio SoC chip market in China, with significant penetration in international first-tier brand supply chains. It competes with global semiconductor companies in the Bluetooth audio and AIoT chip sectors. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, proprietary technologies, and strategic partnerships with major brands position it favorably against competitors, especially in low-power AI edge computing and wireless audio solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 651.9 million, representing a 25.34% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 106.6 million, up 63.83% from the previous year. R&D investment accounted for 33% of revenue, reflecting a 30.06% increase in R&D spending. The company’s total assets grew by 12.22% to RMB 2.16 billion, and net assets increased by 3.85% to RMB 1.88 billion, indicating steady growth and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering low-power, high-performance AIoT chips with superior audio quality, low latency, and advanced wireless communication capabilities. Its proprietary tri-core heterogeneous architecture with CIM-based NPU provides high AI computing power with excellent energy efficiency, enabling sophisticated AI audio processing on edge devices. The integration of customized wireless protocols and advanced audio algorithms offers differentiated high-fidelity sound experiences. The company’s comprehensive hardware-software ecosystem and close collaboration with leading brands further enhance its competitive advantage.
